title: Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst(QA)
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst, you will ensure that the Salesforce solutions our teams rely on are accurate, thoroughly tested, and ready for change. Your work supports the systems that help us manage client relationships, proposals, and contracts, which make it possible to deliver clinical research that advances new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in translating business needs into clear requirements, validating every enhancement before it reaches production, and keeping releases reliable across the sprint cycle.
  
  
You will collaborate with business analysts, developers, administrators, and business stakeholders, work within Agile methodologies, and contribute from requirements through deployment. Responsibilities include business analysis, system and integration testing, Salesforce configuration, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how Salesforce supports our business.
  
  
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous testing, well-documented requirements, and dependable Salesforce releases. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Salesforce Business Analyst and Quality Assurance Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across the Salesforce platform, Agile delivery, and clinical development business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality Assurance: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive system test cases for Salesforce enhancements, including managed packages and connected solutions. Perform regression testing, test integrations with other enterprise systems, maintain testing artifacts, and run end-to-end smoke testing during weekend sprint release deployments, which occur once every three weeks
* Business Analysis: Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and document them as user stories in collaboration with business analysts. Create Visio flows that document new and existing business processes and functionality
* Salesforce Configuration: Administer a range of declarative solutions to support sprint work and resolve production issues when needed
* Collaboration and Issue Resolution: Translate requirements into effective test scenarios, identify, document, and track defects throughout the testing lifecycle, and work with the development and administration team to resolve issues in a timely way. Take part in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and retrospectives
* Customer Support: Provide demos of new enhancements to business stakeholders and support them through user acceptance testing, including test data creation and training
* Continuous Improvement: Analyze bugs, perform root cause analysis, and document results. Stay current on Salesforce releases and assess their impact on existing systems and tests. Proactively suggest improvements to testing processes and tools, and mentor junior team members in Salesforce testing practices and methodologies

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in Salesforce quality assurance, business analysis, and end-to-end testing of Salesforce solutions and their integrations
* A proven track record of providing exceptional customer service to stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite leaders, and managing production issues with meticulous attention to detail
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing
* A proactive mindset, a bias for action, and a flexible approach to new learning and changing priorities
* Comfort working in Agile environments with tools such as Jira, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced setting

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Salesforce Administrator Certification
* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience with a strong focus on business analysis, system and integration testing
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data models, and business processes, and of Salesforce security
* Knowledge of the full sales cycle, from lead generation and request for proposal through the contract lifecycle, including work orders and changes in scope
* Ability to administer all aspects of Sales Cloud, including security and access, configuration (such as Flow, approval processes, validation rules, and Lightning record pages), reports and dashboards, and data management using Data Loader and Workbench
* Proficiency in creating and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts, and experience with automated testing tools for Salesforce (e.g., Selenium, Provar, Copado Robotic Testing)
* Familiarity with API testing tools and techniques
* Practical experience with Agile methodologies and related tools (e.g., Jira)
* Microsoft Excel skills to clean and manipulate data, including formulas to compare datasets
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
* Ability to work in shifts from 12 to 9 PM IST and provide support for weekend releases

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare, clinical development, or a related field
* Business analyst experience

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.
  
  
You will be responsible for:
  

* The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end-to-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.
* Analyzing and understanding the end-to-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.
* Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non-functional requirements.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is understandable to developers/project team.
* Demonstrate strong Problem-solving skills.
* Attending regular team and other required meetings daily/weekly.
* Ensuring clear and accurate communication and responding to data, business, and technology partners and peers in a timely manner.
* Provides updates to senior management, project stakeholders on the progress of the project and or assigned tasks.
* Reports weekly status to senior management and project team as applicable
* Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources
* Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.

This individual:
  

* Must be comfortable working in a scaled agile development environment
* Have an ability to handle multiple requests from varied stakeholders, in a way that maintains clear priority, and ability to adjust when needed
* Be an effective “translator” of business needs into technical requirements
* Demonstrate an ability to build relationships, collaborate, and influence internal and external teams
* Be able to work under guidance of senior team member, take initiative, and get projects completed with great attention to detail and on time.

The experience you bring:
  

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Minimum 5-6 years of business and data analysis experience
* Minimum 4-7 year of experience in the Investment Management industry/Asset Management/Financial Services industry.
* Strong scripting skills in programming languages like SQL and Python, as you will be responsible for writing queries and other data transformation scripts.
* Solid knowledge of Data Life cycle, data governance, data risk, Master data management concepts, data modeling, Business intelligence and analytics concepts.
* Ability to work in a team/group setting.
* Ability to interpret complex or vague instructions and successfully produce results.
* Proactively identifies, analyzes, and resolves procedural fail points.
* Demonstrates superior judgement, reasoning, and follow-up skills.
* Demonstrates a high level of initiative, assertiveness, and self-confidence.
* Proactively identifies and analyzes procedural improvements. Initiate projects/workflow that would enhance the department's functions.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
* Shares information efficiently between team members.
* Promotes Teamwork.
* Effectively manages multiple responsibilities and meets deadlines.
* An understanding of the concepts related to data modelling, coding and process flow design
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Logical and efficient, with attention to detail

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee
  
  
**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
No
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.

* Competitive Compensation

We ensure our manager and leaders also have many opportunities to advance their skills and competencies that becomes pivotal in their continuous pursuit of performance excellence.

title: Digital Engineering Lead
description:
**Digital Engineering Lead**

**Role Purpose**

Provide independent oversight of engineering delivery quality across website development, production support, code quality, release management, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Website Engineering Governance**

· Review technical implementation of the website revamp.

· Validate frontend and backend development standards.

· Ensure reusable and maintainable code practices.

· Review component design, templates, and publishing model.

**Code Quality Assessment**

· Conduct periodic code reviews.

· Assess coding standards and technical debt.

· Validate adherence to secure coding principles.

· Review vendor development practices and recommendations.

**Performance & Digital Experience Assurance**

· Review page performance and Core Web Vitals.

· Validate media optimization practices.

· Review website accessibility compliance.

· Assess SEO technical implementation.

· Ensure responsive design quality across devices.

**Release & Production Readiness**

· Review deployment and release processes.

· Validate UAT and production readiness.

· Review rollback and recovery procedures.

· Assess support model effectiveness across the three production websites.

**Operational Governance**

· Review incident management processes.

· Assess monitoring and alerting capabilities.

· Validate SLA and support model adherence.

· Review vendor support performance and operational maturity.

**Quality Gate Reviews**

· Sprint Reviews

· UAT Readiness Reviews

· Performance Reviews

· Production Readiness Reviews

· Post-Go-Live Health Checks

**Experience Required**

· 10+ years digital engineering experience.

· Experience delivering enterprise CMS platforms.

· Strong understanding of:

o AEM

o React / Front-End Frameworks

o AWS

o API Integrations

o Website Performance Optimization

o Accessibility Standards

o SEO Technical Compliance

· Experience governing system integrators and delivery vendors.
